title: Two-to-four noise norm inequality
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every real-valued function $f$ on $\{\pm1\}^n$, the noise operator with parameter $1/\sqrt{3}$ satisfies $\|T_{1/\sqrt{3}}f\|_4\leq\|f\|_2$, where both norms are taken with respect to uniform measure on the cube.
